stem: If A = 1, B = 2, C = 3 and so on up to Z = 26, the code of a word is the sum of its letters. For example, BAD = 2 + 1 + 4 = 7. What is the code of TOY?
hints: All three letters of TOY are anchor letters: E = 5, J = 10, O = 15, T = 20, Y = 25.
Write T, O and Y as numbers.
T = 20, O = 15 and Y = 25. Add the three numbers.

solution.methodName: Write each letter as its number

steps.action: Write each letter as a number: T = 20, O = 15, Y = 25.
steps.why: The anchors go up by 5: E = 5, J = 10, O = 15, T = 20, Y = 25. Only Z = 26 comes after Y.

trapNotes.45: This adds only T and Y (20 + 25). The code adds every letter, so include O = 15.
trapNotes.59: This counts O as 14, the number for N. O is an anchor letter: O = 15.
trapNotes.61: This counts Y as 26, the number for Z. Y = 25 and Z = 26.
